description:
## Summary

The replacement is exercised as one arc on a rad-initialized repository: work identified → issue lifecycle → ordinary branch and commits → native patch → review → revision → merge → canonical publication → disposition and closure — with recorded durable-state evidence for every required mutation class, on a runa project with **no `[forge]` configuration**. This is the "the workflow works" half of the epic's completion, produced before release; the terminal zero-residue unit re-proves it on the released, installed surfaces.

Part of: #538.

## Scope

- An end-to-end verification run against a real rad-initialized repository
- The recorded evidence and its durable home
- No new architecture — this unit exercises what the station units built

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every lifecycle station executes against a real rad-initialized repository reachable from the declared node topology.
- [ ] Every required mutation class — issue open/comment/claim/close; patch open/revise/review/merge; canonical publication; replication — has read-back durable-state evidence recorded at a durable home.
- [ ] The full run executes on a runa project with no `[forge]` section.
- [ ] The failure discipline is exercised, not just documented: at least one refused or unpropagated mutation is demonstrated to fail its protocol step during the run.
- [ ] Friction surfaced by the run is resolved in-unit or filed as work-units — not routed around.

## Contract inputs

- **Behavior:** the recorded evidence chain reads from work identification to closure with no gap a reviewer must take on faith.
- **Documentation:** the evidence record is the first-contact proof surface for "does this actually work?" — organized by mutation class.
- **Code quality:** evidence over assertion, per the execution-binding register (`policy.toml`).

## Dependencies

Depends on: #603, #605, #600, pentaxis93/babbie-ops#105. External: tesserine/commons#109 (rad-initialized working repositories — beginning with tesserine/groundwork itself).
